title: The Lord as a Sanctuary, a Stone of Stumbling and a Trap
description: The Lord spoke to Isaiah with a mighty hand and warned him not to follow the people's path. They were not to call everything a conspiracy as the people did, nor fear what they feared. The Lord of hosts was to be held holy; he was to be their fear. He would be a sanctuary, but also a stone of stumbling and a rock that causes falling for both houses of Israel, a snare and a trap for the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Many would stumble, fall, be broken, and be caught.
